description: This file defines a remote commit service interface and its implementation, along with transaction operation classes for passing, failing, and throwing exceptions, used within Orleans transaction testing.

classes.name: RemoteCommitService
classes.description: Implements IRemoteCommitService to simulate transaction outcomes for testing, with methods to pass, fail, or throw exceptions.

classes.name: PassOperation
classes.description: Represents a successful commit operation with associated data, implements ITransactionCommitOperation for RemoteCommitService.

classes.name: FailOperation
classes.description: Represents a failed commit operation with associated data, implements ITransactionCommitOperation for RemoteCommitService.

classes.name: ThrowOperation
classes.description: Represents an operation that throws an exception during commit, used for fault testing, implements ITransactionCommitOperation for RemoteCommitService.

methods.name: Pass
methods.description: Simulates a successful transaction commit, logs info, delays, and returns true.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Simulates a failed transaction commit, logs info, delays, and returns false.

methods.name: Throw
methods.description: Simulates an exception during transaction commit, logs info, delays, and throws ApplicationException.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Executes the commit operation for the specific transaction, calling the corresponding method on the service.
